control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas
application of positive isolation devices and personal locks
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: trapped hazardous energy found after isolation of TX-3002

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on TX-3002 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on TX-3002 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. TX-3002 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 23 September 2016 a potential incident was recorded on TX-3002 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during start-up after maintenance; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
